To resolve this systemic amnesia, the witness evolved into a disk-backed entity. By appending events to a JSONL (JSON Lines) file, the witness transformed into a persistent, queryable record. Every action, prompt, and response is now durably logged to disk. This format ensures that the history survives across restarts and is natively parsable, allowing the substrate to reconstruct its past states and inspect its own operational trajectory at will.
